subject: Feedback request after attachment issue
text: Good afternoon, I wanted to ask a brief question about the material I sent to the group earlier. I only noticed after leaving the office that the attachment may not have opened properly on my side, and I would prefer to correct that before collecting opinions. The document itself is still available, but the supporting table was probably left out during upload. If you saw only the main text, please do not spend time evaluating the numbers section. I would rather hear your thoughts once the missing piece is visible. The feedback I need is limited to clarity, sequence, and whether the appendix answers the questions raised in the first part. There is no need for detailed comments, and I understand that many of you have prior commitments. A short reply identifying one confusing point would be helpful. If you cannot open the attachment after I resend it, let me know quietly rather than replying to everyone, because the file contains only internal draft content. I am asking because we need to decide quickly which version to circulate next. The deadline is not severe, but a delay in feedback would make the next step harder. Thank you for taking a moment with this. Your perspective matters because you read the work closely and with care. I can also provide a plain-text summary if that is easier. Please use the original message chain when you respond, so the context remains clear. I will review all notes in one pass and acknowledge them once the final draft is ready.
